pageDescription: Compares the contents of the files in a folder to find identical copies. You always keep at least one copy in each group; nothing is deleted without confirmation.
idleDescription: File names and sizes in the folder are read, and contents only for files of the same size.
checkMatchDetail: First the size and the first 4 KB, then a SHA-256 hash of the whole file.
checkKeepDetail: The first copy in each group stays: a file with other hard links, otherwise the one with the shortest path.
checkSkipDetail: Symbolic links, files outside the filters and folders excluded here or in Settings.
scanCancelled: Search stopped: the results are partial.
keepOneCopy: At least one copy stays in each group
hardLinkedCopy: Other hard links keep this file, so deleting it would free no space
emptyDescription: No files with identical content under the current filters
confirmRecycleTitle_one: Move {{copies}} copy to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})?
confirmRecycleTitle_other: Move {{copies}} copies to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})?
confirmRecycleDesc: At least one copy stays in each group. Before it is moved, each copy is compared again with the one that stays and skipped if it changed or is excluded. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.
confirmPermanentDesc: At least one copy stays in each group, and each copy is verified again before it is deleted. This cannot be undone: the files do not go to the Recycle Bin.
deletingRecycle_one: Moving {{copies}} copy to the Recycle Bin
deletingRecycle_other: Moving {{copies}} copies to the Recycle Bin
deletingFacts: Each copy is verified again before it is touched.
receiptRecycleTitle: Copies moved to the Recycle Bin
receiptRecycleNote: restorable from the Recycle Bin; the space is freed when you empty it
receiptSkipped_one: {{skipped}} file skipped: each copy is verified again and skipped if it changed, is excluded or is the last one left.
receiptSkipped_other: {{skipped}} files skipped: each copy is verified again and skipped if it changed, is excluded or is the last one left.
deleteRecycleToast_one: {{copies}} copy moved to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})
deleteRecycleToast_other: {{copies}} copies moved to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})
